entities.name: Pierre Joseph Bonnaterre
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abbé Pierre Joseph Bonnaterre was a French zoologist who contributed sections on cetaceans, mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects to the Tableau encyclopédique et méthodique. He is also notable as the first scientist to study the feral child Victor of Aveyron.
